title: Remove Nth Node From End of List
goal: Solve Remove Nth Node From End of List: Separate two list pointers by the requested gap, then advance together to locate the predecessor of the node counted from the end.
strategy: Separate two list pointers by the requested gap, then advance together to locate the predecessor of the node counted from the end.
edgeCases: Removing the head needs a dummy predecessor; the requested position must be within the list.
